bullets.id: Emas menutup pekan di sekitar $4.194, naik 1,5% pada Jumat dan sekitar 1,3% sepekan, kenaikan mingguan pertama dalam tiga pekan. Harga sempat menyentuh $4.207,48 pada Jumat pagi setelah jatuh ke terendah dua bulan $4.090 pada Rabu. Survei Kitco: 7 dari 14 analis Wall Street bullish, 2 bearish dan 5 netral; investor ritel 45% memperkirakan naik.
bullets.en: Gold ended the week around $4,194, up 1.5% on Friday and about 1.3% on the week, its first weekly gain in three weeks. It touched $4,207.48 early Friday after falling to a two-month low of $4,090 on Wednesday. Kitco’s survey: 7 of 14 Wall Street analysts are bullish, 2 bearish and 5 neutral; 45% of retail investors expect a rise.

bullets.id: Yield 10 tahun AS ditutup di 5,244% dan yield 30 tahun mundur ke 5,600% dari 5,732% pada Rabu, tertinggi sejak 2004. Indeks dolar di 101,9. CME FedWatch memberi peluang 19% kenaikan suku bunga Oktober dan 84% setidaknya satu kenaikan hingga Desember. Emas masih turun 2,86% sebulan dan sekitar 25% di bawah rekor Januari $5.608.
bullets.en: The US 10-year yield closed at 5.244% and the 30-year eased to 5.600% from 5.732% on Wednesday, its highest since 2004. The dollar index is at 101.9. CME FedWatch puts the odds of an October hike at 19% and of at least one hike by December at 84%. Gold is still down 2.86% on the month and about 25% below its January record of $5,608.

bullets.id: Pemicu utama pekan ini: CPI September pada Rabu 14 Oktober pukul 19.30 WIB, dengan konsensus inflasi 3,7% (dari 3,4%) dan inti 0,2% bulanan. Kamis ada PPI, penjualan ritel dan klaim pengangguran, lalu pidato Ketua Fed Warsh. Resistance di $4.200, $4.230 dan $4.251; support di $4.100, $4.000 dan $3.950.
bullets.en: This week’s main catalyst is September CPI on Wednesday, October 14 at 8:30 a.m. ET, with consensus at 3.7% inflation (from 3.4%) and 0.2% monthly core. Thursday brings PPI, retail sales and jobless claims, then a speech by Fed Chair Warsh. Resistance sits at $4,200, $4,230 and $4,251; support at $4,100, $4,000 and $3,950.

bullets.id: Antam bertahan di Rp2.592.000/gram dengan buyback Rp2.401.000, spread Rp191.000 (sekitar 7,4%). Galeri24 naik ke Rp2.532.000 (buyback Rp2.386.000) dan UBS ke Rp2.556.000 (buyback Rp2.360.000). Bank sentral China menambah 21 ton emas pada September menjadi 2.196 ton, bulan ke-23 berturut-turut.
bullets.en: Antam held at Rp2,592,000/gram with buyback at Rp2,401,000, a spread of Rp191,000 (about 7.4%). Galeri24 rose to Rp2,532,000 (buyback Rp2,386,000) and UBS to Rp2,556,000 (buyback Rp2,360,000). China’s central bank added 21 tonnes of gold in September to 2,196 tonnes, its 23rd straight month.
